snippet.title: Decommission Protocol Trailer
snippet.description:
Edith station has been abandoned for a year - an unusually long time to sit derelict. You are a space station engineer sent up to decommission the station in a manual service elevator with the ability to stop between floors. Will you discover the truth or simply follow protocol?

Play the free demo on Steam now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4534680/Decommission_Protocol/
